description: brainstorm-toolkit — surface the .next-action seam. Enabling the plugin wires the Stop hook in EVERY repo (no per-repo setup.sh needed), so /brainstorm handoffs, /sdlc-lite --queue park-resumes, and gotcha seams actually appear as `Next: …` (and, with pipeline.auto_continue, drive the loop). Merges with any user/project Stop hooks (deduped by command). See docs/SEAM.md.
